test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 15 men can do a work in 15 days working 8 hours a day. N men can do twice the work in 20 days working 10 hours a day. What is the value of N?
solution:
**Given:**

M1 = 15, D1 = 15, H₁ = 8 and

M₂ = N, D2 = 20, H2 = 10

**Concept used:**

(M1D1H1)/W1 = (M2D2H2)/W2 

M₁ = men or women in first group

D1 = days to complete the work by first group

H1 = working hours in a day by first group

W1 = work done by first group

M2 = men or women in second group

D2 = days to complete the work by second group

H2 = working hours in a day by second group.

W2 = work done by second group

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

2(W1) = W2 

Then,

(15 × 15 × 8)/(W1) = (N × 20 × 10)/2(W1)

⇒ 2(15 × 15 × 8) = (N × 20 × 10)

⇒ 2(1800) = N × 200

⇒ 3600 = N × 200

⇒ N = 3600/200 = 18

**∴ The value of N is 18.**
